reason: Identical visibility under open/closed opaque security doors despite different backgrounds. PlayCanvas RenderPass depth storage defaults false for transient renderbuffer targets. Native WebGL can invalidate that attachment before external copies.
correction: Separate CCTV adapter using explicit depth textures, whose RenderPass storeDepth is true. Historical helper and baseline are unchanged.
required_retest: Full stored-depth open/closed probes, useful pixel coverage and negative control; no gate inferred from the invalidated values.
